waitlist.description: First come, first served. When a spot frees up before the cancellation deadline, the first in line gets it automatically.

shiftEdit.description: Everyone with a spot keeps it and is told what changed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: How your agency handles requests and cancellations.
settings.autoConfirmHint: Workers get the spot right away, without your approval. Applies to new requests.
settings.waitlistHint: Workers can join the waitlist of a full shift in the app. When a spot frees up, the first in line moves up automatically. Switched off, nobody new can join; whoever is already waiting stays in line.
settings.deadlineHint: How long before the start workers can cancel in the app. 0 means until the start.
settings.adminsOnly: Only admins can change the settings.

error.title: The settings could not be loaded
error.description: Please try again. If the problem persists, reload the page.

features.title: Optional features
features.contactButtonHint: Workers see a button on every shift that opens WhatsApp with the contact person. For agencies that prefer that.
features.checkInHint: Workers check in and out of their shifts in the app. Without it, hours are approved from the planned times.
features.clientPortalHint: Your clients log in to the dashboard and see their shifts and the names of confirmed workers, but no hourly rates. You give access under “Clients”. While it's off, no client can log in.
